page_text_en:
Growing up, what will I do?
Chef
summary_zh: 本页以标题形式提出问题‘长大干什么’，并给出答案‘厨师’，配图是一个戴着厨师帽、手持厨具的卡通儿童形象。

page_text_ocr_zh:
餐厅
我们每天都要吃饭。
我和爸爸妈妈经常在家吃饭，但偶尔也会去外面的餐厅吃饭。
在餐厅，我们可以一边吃饭，一边和家人聊天。
我们从菜单上选择自己喜欢吃的菜肴，
不一会儿，服务生就会把香喷喷的菜肴端上来，这可都是厨师做的哦！
（当然，并不是他一个人做的，而是由团队共同完成的。）
page_text_en:
Restaurant
We eat every day.
My parents and I often eat at home, but sometimes we go to a restaurant.
At a restaurant, we can eat while chatting with our family.
We choose our favorite dishes from the menu,
and soon, the waiter will bring us delicious food—this is all made by the chef!
(Of course, it's not done by one person alone, but by a team.)
summary_zh: 本页通过文字和插图介绍了餐厅用餐的场景，说明人们在餐厅可以与家人一起吃饭、点菜，并指出美味菜肴是由厨师团队共同完成的。

page_text_ocr_zh:
厨师帽
厨师领巾
厨师服
长围裙
安全鞋
工作时，厨师穿着厨师服，戴着厨师帽，系着厨师领巾。
他的腰上系着一条长围裙，这样衣服就不会被弄脏了。
此外，厨师还穿着一双安全鞋来保护自己的脚。
page_text_en:
Chef's hat
Chef's neckerchief
Chef's coat
Long apron
Safety shoes
When working, chefs wear chef's coats, chef's hats, and chef's neckerchiefs.
They tie a long apron around their waist so their clothes won't get dirty.
In addition, chefs wear a pair of safety shoes to protect their feet.
summary_zh: 本页通过图文介绍了厨师的工作服，包括厨师帽、厨师领巾、厨师服、长围裙和安全鞋，并解释了这些装备的用途。

page_text_ocr_zh:
厨师在一个有烤箱、炉灶和工作台的大厨房里工作。
厨房里有很多厨具：各式各样的刀、勺子、搅拌器、
打蛋器、锅、碗、盘子……
当然，要做出美味的菜肴，食材也是必不可少的。
有些食材需要保鲜，像蔬菜、水果、鱼和肉等，厨师
会把它们放进冷藏库。
有些食材可以存放久一些，像罐头、鸡蛋、牛奶和油
等，就不需要放进冷藏库了。
做好充足的准备后，厨师才能开始工作哦！
油炸锅
炉灶
烤箱

page_text_en:
Chefs work in a large kitchen with an oven, stove, and workbench.
There are many kitchen tools in the kitchen: various knives, spoons, mixers,
egg beaters, pots, bowls, plates, and more.
Of course, to make delicious dishes, ingredients are also essential.
Some ingredients need to be kept fresh, like vegetables, fruits, fish, and meat, so chefs
put them in the refrigerator.
Some ingredients can be stored for longer, like canned goods, eggs, milk, and oil,
so they don't need to be put in the refrigerator.
After making full preparations, chefs can finally start working!

summary_zh: 本页介绍了厨师工作的大厨房环境，展示了厨房中常见的厨具和食材，并说明了食材的储存方式，强调了准备工作对厨师工作的重要性。

page_text_ocr_zh:
厨师对食材和调料非常了解，所以才会研制出好吃又健康的新菜品。
当他们做出新的菜肴后，会把新菜名写在菜单上，
这样顾客就可以选择他们喜欢的新菜肴了。
好厨师做菜喜欢用新鲜的食材，比如夏天的番茄、
冬天的豆芽。
page_text_en:
Chefs know a lot about ingredients and seasonings, so they can create delicious and healthy new dishes.
After they make a new dish, they write the name on the menu,
so customers can choose the new dishes they like.
Good chefs like to use fresh ingredients, such as tomatoes in summer,
and bean sprouts in winter.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了厨师如何研发新菜品并将其加入菜单，强调了使用新鲜食材的重要性，配图展示了一个厨师正在记录菜谱的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
早晨，鱼店老板会送来新鲜的鱼，
菜店老板会送来新鲜的蔬菜，
肉店老板会送来新鲜的肉。
有时，厨师会早早去市场采购需要的食材。
所有新鲜的食材都会被放进冷藏库里，这样可以
保鲜更久。
冷藏库很大，你可以在里面走来走去。
每天，厨师都要提前准备好足够的食材，把它们
放进冷藏库里，为第二天的营业做准备。
page_text_en:
In the morning, the fish shop owner will deliver fresh fish,
the vegetable shop owner will deliver fresh vegetables,
and the meat shop owner will deliver fresh meat.
Sometimes, the chef will go to the market early to buy the needed ingredients.
All fresh ingredients will be put into the cold storage, so they can
stay fresh for longer.
The cold storage is very big, and you can walk around inside.
Every day, the chef must prepare enough ingredients in advance, put them
into the cold storage, and get ready for the next day's business.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了厨师每天早晨接收新鲜食材的过程，包括鱼、蔬菜和肉类，并说明这些食材会被存入冷藏库以保鲜，为第二天的营业做准备。

page_text_ocr_zh:
早晨，厨师们准备就绪，等待主厨分配工作。
每位厨师都有自己的任务，有的做菜，有的熬汤，
还有的做甜点……
餐厅还没开始营业呢，可厨师们早就忙碌起来了。
当然，厨师们在工作前都会洗手，这一点非常重要！
一切准备好后，餐厅就开始营业啦！
page_text_en:
In the morning, the chefs are ready and waiting for the head chef to assign tasks.
Each chef has their own job—some cook dishes, some make soup,
and others prepare desserts...
The restaurant hasn't opened yet, but the chefs are already busy.
Of course, chefs always wash their hands before working—it's very important!
Once everything is ready, the restaurant opens for business!
summary_zh: 本页描述了餐厅开业前厨师们的工作准备情况，包括分配任务、各司其职以及洗手等卫生步骤，强调了准备工作的重要性。

page_text_ocr_zh:
看，厨师的工作可不容易哦！
他们要把新鲜的鱼洗净准备好，把蔬菜洗净切好，
放进小碗里备用。
现在一切都准备好了：锅、盘子、所有的食材……
这样，如果有人点菜，厨师就能尽快做好，
顾客不用等太久就能吃到美味的菜肴啦！
是不是很方便呢？
page_text_en:
Look, being a chef is not easy!
They have to clean and prepare fresh fish, wash and chop vegetables,
and put them in small bowls for later use.
Now everything is ready: pots, plates, and all the ingredients...
This way, when someone orders a dish, the chef can cook it quickly,
and customers don't have to wait long to enjoy delicious food!
Isn't that convenient?
summary_zh: 本页通过图文展示了厨师在餐厅开业前的准备工作，包括清洗鱼和蔬菜，并将食材切好备用，强调了充分准备对快速出餐的重要性。

page_text_ocr_zh:
餐厅开始营业了。
看，一号桌的八位顾客已经点好菜了。
而在厨房里，厨师们有的切菜，有的做鱼，
已经忙得热火朝天了。
先放点儿盐，再撒点儿胡椒，嗯，味道一定棒极了……
瞧，二号桌和三号桌的顾客也点好菜了。
这下，厨师们就更忙了！
page_text_en:
The restaurant is now open for business.
Look, the eight customers at Table 1 have already ordered their meals.
In the kitchen, the chefs are busy chopping vegetables and cooking fish,
already working hard and bustling.
First, add a bit of salt, then sprinkle some pepper. Mmm, this will taste wonderful...
Look, the customers at Table 2 and Table 3 have also ordered their meals.
Now the chefs are even busier!
summary_zh: 餐厅开始营业，顾客陆续点餐，厨房里的厨师们忙碌地准备菜肴，随着订单增多，工作节奏加快。

page_text_ocr_zh:
叮！
厨师把香喷喷的炸鱼放进盘子里，
然后又用土豆泥、胡萝卜酱和新鲜的蔬菜做点缀。
这样下来，整道菜色泽鲜艳，就像一幅美丽的图画。
很快，客人们点过的菜都做好了。
叮——
厨师一按响铃铛，服务员就立即把菜端上了餐桌。
page_text_en:
Ding!
The chef puts the fragrant fried fish into the plate,
then decorates it with mashed potatoes, carrot sauce, and fresh vegetables.
This way, the whole dish is colorful and looks like a beautiful painting.
Soon, all the dishes ordered by the customers are ready.
Ding——
The chef rings the bell, and the waiter immediately serves the dishes to the table.
summary_zh: 厨师将炸鱼装盘并用土豆泥、胡萝卜酱和蔬菜点缀，使菜肴美观，随后按响铃铛，服务员将菜端上餐桌。

page_text_ocr_zh:
过了一会儿，三号桌的顾客点了几份甜点，厨师
立刻开始准备了。
香草冰激凌、草莓巧克力冰激凌、自制奶油蛋糕……
做好的甜点看起来漂亮极了，就像一个色彩派对！
而另一边，厨师正在为七号桌的顾客煎法式牛排。
餐厅的每位厨师都在努力工作。
page_text_en:
After a while, the customer at Table 3 ordered several desserts, and the chef
immediately began preparing them.
Vanilla ice cream, strawberry chocolate ice cream, homemade cream cake...
The finished desserts looked beautiful, like a colorful party!
Meanwhile, another chef was frying a French steak for the customer at Table 7.
Every chef in the restaurant was working hard.
summary_zh: 本页描述了餐厅营业中，厨师们同时准备甜点和牛排的场景，展示了厨房的忙碌与分工，强调了每位厨师都在努力工作。

page_text_ocr_zh:
已经很晚了，厨师们还在辛苦地忙碌着。
临走前，七号桌的顾客对主厨说：“谢谢你，
让我今晚吃到这么美味的菜肴。”
主厨为厨师们感到自豪，他立刻将这个好消息
告诉了大家。
下班前，厨师们会把厨房收拾得干干净净，
并且还会检查食材是否充足。
page_text_en:
It's already very late, and the chefs are still working hard.
Before leaving, the customer at Table 7 says to the head chef: "Thank you, for letting me enjoy such delicious food tonight."
The head chef feels proud of his team and immediately shares this good news with everyone.
Before leaving work, the chefs will clean the kitchen thoroughly,
and they will also check if the ingredients are sufficient.
summary_zh: 本页描述了餐厅营业结束后的场景：顾客感谢主厨，主厨为团队感到自豪并分享好消息；下班前，厨师们会清洁厨房并检查食材储备。
